item.title: CVE-2026-120387 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 10.0
item.description: Tuesday 17 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 10.0 | An improper JWT signature verification vulnerability in CIRCUTOR PowerStudio SCADA WAVE desktop version allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass authentication by submitting an unsigned JWT with the algorithm set to “none”. item.title: CVE-2026-121684 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.1
item.description: Tuesday 17 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.1 | The Soledad theme for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in versions up to, and including, 8.7.7 The public penci_more_post_ajax AJAX action feeds infeedads[ads_code] (base64+urldecoded) to penci_safe_shortcode(), whose allowlist regex inspects only the hyphen-truncated outer shortcode name (e.g. 'adinserter') and never the nested [elementor-element k=.. data=..] tag, so do_shortcode() renders an attacker-chosen Elementor element. The rendered penci-featured-sliders widget passes its unsanitized 'style' setting to include dirname(__FILE__)."/{$style}.php", a path-traversal local file inclusion.
